titleEn: Number of People Aware of a Secret
title: 知道秘密的人数
summary: 第一天一人知道秘密，每人在知道 delay 天后开始每天分享给一名新人，并在 forget 天后忘记，求第 n 天结束时仍知道秘密的人数。
insight: learn[day] 记录当天新知道的人数，sharing 维护当天能够分享的人数。每天加入 day-delay 批次、移除 day-forget 批次，新学习人数就是 sharing。
pitfalls: 忘记秘密当天不能再分享
答案包含尚未开始分享但仍记得的人
所有加减都要规范取模

solutions.title: 每日新增人数滑动窗口
solutions.idea: 用可分享人群的进入与退出维护递推。
steps: 汇总 day=max(1,n-forget+1)..n 的 learn 并取模

code.java: class Solution { public int peopleAwareOfSecret(int n,int delay,int forget){long mod=1_000_000_007L;long[] learn=new long[n+1];learn[1]=1;long sharing=0;for(int day=2;day<=n;day++){if(day-delay>=1)sharing=(sharing+learn[day-delay])%mod;if(day-forget>=1)sharing=(sharing-learn[day-forget]+mod)%mod;learn[day]=sharing;}long answer=0;for(int day=Math.max(1,n-forget+1);day<=n;day++)answer=(answer+learn[day])%mod;return (int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun peopleAwareOfSecret(n:Int,delay:Int,forget:Int):Int{val mod=1_000_000_007L;val learn=LongArray(n+1);learn[1]=1;var sharing=0L;for(day in 2..n){if(day-delay>=1)sharing=(sharing+learn[day-delay])%mod;if(day-forget>=1)sharing=(sharing-learn[day-forget]+mod)%mod;learn[day]=sharing};var answer=0L;for(day in maxOf(1,n-forget+1)..n)answer=(answer+learn[day])%mod;return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int peopleAwareOfSecret(int n,int delay,int forget){const long long mod=1000000007;vector<long long> learn(n+1);learn[1]=1;long long sharing=0;for(int day=2;day<=n;++day){if(day-delay>=1)sharing=(sharing+learn[day-delay])%mod;if(day-forget>=1)sharing=(sharing-learn[day-forget]+mod)%mod;learn[day]=sharing;}long long answer=0;for(int day=max(1,n-forget+1);day<=n;++day)answer=(answer+learn[day])%mod;return answer;} };
